query: Historical FIFA World Cup red cards per match rate statistics all tournaments 1998-2022
answer:
I've completed the research on FIFA World Cup red cards per match rates for tournaments from 1998-2022. 

**Key findings:** All seven tournaments used the identical 32-team/64-match format, allowing clean comparison. The red-cards-per-match rate peaked at **0.438 in 2006 Germany** (28 red cards, an all-time record) and fell steadily to a historic low of **0.063 in both 2018 Russia and 2022 Qatar** (4 red cards each), coinciding with the introduction of VAR. The full trajectory: 1998 (0.344) → 2002 (0.266) → 2006 (0.438) → 2010 (0.266) → 2014 (0.156) → 2018 (0.063) → 2022 (0.063), for an aggregate of ~0.228 red cards per match across the period. Data was cross-validated across Planet World Cup, Wikipedia, travelnotes.org, Opta Analyst, and Statista, with source discrepancies noted (2006: 27 vs 28; 2002: 17 confirmed; 2022: 4 players vs 6 with coaches).
